title: Bias In, Bias Out? Finding Unbiased Subnetworks in Vanilla Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on unbiased test sets of BiasedMNIST, Multi-Color MNIST, and Corrupted-CIFAR10 to measure the model's reliance on synthetic background colors or injected image corruptions that are spuriously correlated with the target labels.

Evaluating the performance of hair color classification on the CelebA dataset using an unbiased test set to measure and mitigate the model's reliance on the spuriously correlated perceived gender attribute.

Measuring worst-group accuracy (WGA) on the CivilComments text dataset for toxicity classification to evaluate bias against mentions of sensitive attributes, which are aggregated into a single indicator encompassing gender, race, religion, and sexual orientation.
